ratings.notes: Vulnerable/armoured relates to harm and protection.
Warm/cold can signal kindness versus lack of care.
Slothful suggests lack of self-discipline and a general vice.
Obedient/rebellious directly concerns authority; rebellious can imply resistance to control.
Class terms relate to hierarchy and social/economic inequality.
Sensitive can relate to hurt or empathy.
Charisma can relate to leadership and prestige.
Gracious suggests kind or gentle interpersonal treatment.
Sheeple implies uncritical followership of authority.
Neat/messy relates to cleanliness and order.
